description: This file contains a suite of tests for verifying the behavior of page closing in the Playwright testing framework, including handling dialogs, ensuring promises reject properly, and behaviors related to page closure events.

methods.name: should close page with active dialog
methods.description: Tests that the page can be closed while a dialog (alert) is active and properly handles the dialog event.

methods.name: should not accept dialog after close
methods.description: Verifies that dialogs are rejected after the page has been closed, ensuring dialogs cannot be interacted with post-closure.

methods.name: expect should not print timed out error message when page closes
methods.description: Ensures that the timeout error message is suppressed when the page is closed before an expectation times out.

methods.name: addLocatorHandler should throw when page closes
methods.description: Tests that attempting to add a locator handler after the page is closed throws an appropriate error.

methods.name: should reject all promises when page is closed
methods.description: Ensures that pending promises (e.g., evaluations) are rejected with an appropriate error when the page is closed.

methods.name: should set the page close state
methods.description: Checks that the page correctly reports its closed state before and after being closed.

methods.name: should pass page to close event
methods.description: Verifies that the page object passed to the 'close' event is the same as the one that was closed.

methods.name: should terminate network waiters
methods.description: Checks that network request and response waiters are properly terminated when the page is closed.

methods.name: should be callable twice
methods.description: Ensures that calling page.close() multiple times does not cause errors.

methods.name: should return null if parent page has been closed
methods.description: Verifies that calling opener() on a popup returns null if the parent page was closed.

methods.name: should fail with error upon disconnect
methods.description: Tests that a proper error is thrown when attempting to wait for an event (like download) after the page has been closed.

methods.name: page.close should work with window.close
methods.description: Verifies that calling page.close() works correctly when the page is closed via window.close().

methods.name: should not throw UnhandledPromiseRejection when page closes
methods.description: Ensures that no unhandled promise rejections occur when the page is closed during ongoing operations.

methods.name: interrupt request.response() and request.allHeaders() on page.close
methods.description: Checks that in-flight network requests are properly interrupted and relevant promises reject with an appropriate error.

methods.name: should not treat navigations as new popups
methods.description: Verifies that navigations triggered from links do not cause new popup events mistakenly.

methods.name: should not result in unhandled rejection
methods.description: Ensures that calling exposeFunction and evaluating code does not cause unhandled rejections after page closure.

methods.name: should reject response.finished if page closes
methods.description: Tests that the response.finished() promise rejects with an error indicating the page was closed.

methods.name: should not throw when continuing while page is closing
methods.description: Ensures that route.continue() calls do not throw errors if the page is being closed during the route handling.

methods.name: should not throw when continuing after page is closed
methods.description: Verifies that route.continue() rejects appropriately when the page has been closed.

ctags.name: closedPromise
ctags.pattern: /^  const closedPromise = new Promise(x => page.on('close', x));$/
